14.t: Working with data: electrons and the periodic table
q: How many electrons does a sodium atom have?
Write the electron arrangement of argon.
State the group of chlorine and calcium, and explain how you know.
Chlorine group 7, calcium group 2: the group number equals the number of outer-shell electrons.
Explain why argon is unreactive but chlorine is very reactive.
Argon has a full outer shell, so it does not gain or lose electrons. Chlorine needs just one more electron to fill its shell, so it reacts readily.
